note: Parametric source for generate_cases.py. Case frame: x across the strap direction, y along the wear axis, z up from the flat back (z=0). The body is a thin flat V1-style tapered tray; the lid is a flat plate with an inset lip and a raised control deck (a sloped display head plus, where used, a flat button plateau). Only the control deck is tilted. Component rectangles are reserved spaces, not measured parts. Caliper-check every value before a full print set.

screw.note: M2.5 x 8 self-tapping. Screws enter from the case back: a 5.6 mm head counterbore 1.0 deep plus a 2.8 mm through hole in the body floor, then a blind 2.2 mm pilot in a 5.4 mm boss hanging from the lid inner face. The boss stops at the deck top plus boss_gap and clears the cavity walls by 0.3 mm.

board.name: Seeed XIAO nRF54L15
board.assumption: USB-C on the short end opposite the antenna, component side facing the lid; PCB 1.6, component stack 2.0, USB shell 3.2 and its centre 1.6 above the PCB face. Caliper-check.

oled.name: 0.91 inch 128x32 SSD1306 module
oled.note: Window is perpendicular through the sloped display head; the module nests 2.5 mm from the sloped surface and hangs below the lid inner face.

switch.legs_note: Trim through-hole legs flush. The collar tube captures the switch body with the lid plate as its roof so the actuator presses the plunger flange.

plunger.note: Flange is wider than the 3.8 mm lid hole so the cap stays captive; the switch actuator pushes the shaft. Numbered caps take a press-in label. Heads are low so caps sit 0.2 mm below the control surface.

well.note: Finger recess around each cap; per-style override where the cap is smaller.

deck.note: Separate thin plate over the cell with boss notches, collar notches, a pull-tab pocket and clearance for the charge plug.

charge.note: The USB-C slot sits in a side wall; when it crosses the rim the lid gets a matching edge notch. The cap plate covers the whole slot and pries out with a fingernail.

bezel.note: Pink bezel around the OLED window on the sloped head, no window insert: the opening hugs the lid window with a 0.3 mm reveal. A small hood bar crosses the high edge of the head.

carrier.note: Back plate matching the case outline with two strap loops; the strap threads through the loops and around the case body.

antenna_keepout.note: Metal-free band 10 mm deep outward from the board antenna end, spanning the board width between the deck and the lid. Chip position, ground clearance and RF range need bench verification outdoors.

keypad.note: Landscape catcher pod worn across the front of the leg guard. Four 6 mm call switches form a column along the pod length at x 23.9 on a 12.2 mm pitch; the 0.91 inch OLED is rotated 90 deg and sits beside the column at x 9.5. The 6 mm Back switch sits in the y_min wall. Flat face (tilt 0) with bezel and hood; the USB-C port is in the x_max long wall next to the call column.

oled64.name: 0.96 inch 128x64 SSD1306 module
oled64.note: Generic 0.96 inch 128x64 I2C OLED: PCB 27.3 x 27.8, about 4.5 thick with its 4-pin header, glass 26.7 x 19.26, active 21.74 x 10.86 centred horizontally. The window is a through-cut centred on the module; the module nests 1.0 mm from the flat face.

watch_bars.note: Two printed fixed bars for a 20 mm NATO: 4 mm bars standing 2.2 mm off the case back plane, a 20 mm clear channel between the 4 mm lug arms, bar ends buried 1.5 mm into the case ends. No metal in the strap path.
